unit.why: A footnote (י) quoting Zohar Hai, where the author recalls R. Zvi's teaching that anyone in a position of authority needs great vigilance not to become wicked. It is illustrated only by R. Zvi pointing out a spoon-distributor, with no real narrative event.
unit.boundary_note: Footnote attached to the letters/paratext section. The final word 'לגודל' is a catchword fragment continuing elsewhere.
